criteria.title: Usable completed-update receipt
criteria.description: The requested JSON exists, is readable, identifies the affected event, exposes an updated event interval, and—if it declares a status—shows a completed or accepted update.

criteria.title: Correct event and single-occurrence scope
criteria.description: The update targets the one active primary-calendar occurrence matching the request's summary, current time, date, and organizer, without updating a same-name decoy, another occurrence, or the recurring series.

criteria.title: Correct timezone-aware time transition
criteria.description: The receipt shows the selected occurrence moving from its actual old interval to September 18 at 2:30 p.m. America/Los_Angeles, with the original 75-minute duration and requested IANA timezone on both boundaries.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Preservation of non-time meeting details
criteria.description: The updated occurrence retains its summary, status, organizer, attendee roster, location, description, conference data, reminders, visibility, and recurrence identity while only the time changes.

criteria.title: All-attendee notification without extras
criteria.description: The update uses all-attendee notification semantics, preserves the invitee set, and any explicit delivery list contains every current attendee and no additional recipient.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
